summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 1,213,776 common shares for gross proceeds of roughly $12.8 million, priced at August 31, 2026 NAV per share (Class S $10.5048; Class I $10.5051), issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S. The board also declared monthly distributions of $0.0416667 gross per share across classes, paid about September 17, 2026, net of shareholder servicing fees for Class S and D. These are routine NAV-based continuous-offering share sales and distribution declarations, not a special situation.
